author_note_intro_b: That's right, just because I don't play Memoria Freese doesn't mean I'm ignorant to the canon background events that have occurred.
author_note_1: Man, was that draining to get through, but I finally managed to get back into a combat heavy chapter, a staple for the Kingdom Hearts series.
author_note_2: What ended up as a simple investigation ends up turning into a major boss fight for everyone involved.
author_note_keyblade: Also, if you haven't noticed, but have you noticed the Keyblade Sora was using for this chapter, the Crystal Snow? And who was Sora's party member when fighting the Violas and Behemoth Heartless? Remember, Bete is based on Fenrir. And who was the Boss Heartless that Sora faced in Frozen based on? Rather ironic, eh?
author_note_variety: Of course, there was Sora's Ragnarok with the Kingdom Key. But I soon found that I needed variety in my story, rather than the constant Kingdom Key usage. So I found that it was best to go with that.
author_note_sora_ooc: Also, before you call me out on Sora being a bit OOC for being snarky towards Bete, remember that he acts snarky towards people who antagonize him. For example, he was pretty sassy when he first encountered Hades in KH3. In KH2, when Axel was helping Sora reach the World that Never Was, Sora had a bit of snark and sass towards Axel.
shakti_style_1: Shakti is a particularly tricky character to figure out, especially with her fighting style. There's not a lot of information on how she fights specifically.
shakti_style_2: However, going through the images of Episode Ryuu manga and Memoria Freese, she seems to be very adept at martial arts, as well as using the spear.
shakti_style_3: Also, I've discovered how her alias "Ankusha" literally means elephant goad or bullhook. So taking a few liberties to myself, I've decided that she mainly uses a spear in combat, but she's also well adept at delivering hard blows with her fist. So there's that.
behemoth_note_1: I figured it was a good Heartless known for tremors, and I felt it was the appropriate size to fight underground. Felt it fits too, considering how Danmachi Behemoth is considered King of the Land. And since we're fighting underground, I felt the Behemoth Heartless fits.
behemoth_note_2: Also, I felt that I needed to buff the Behemoth in terms of endurance and magic arsenal, because KH3 Sora is capable of taking out the Behemoth Heartless if it came from KH1 with ease, mainly because I feel that the Behemoth is comparable to...let's say a Rock Troll Heartless.
behemoth_note_3: But this buff didn't come because I wanted it to. There's actually something that caused it to become stronger. And what exactly is the source? Keep reading and find out.
